## Summary

Describe the change.

## Why

Explain the security, privacy, usability, or maintainability problem being addressed.

## Testing

Describe the tests performed.

## Detection impact

If detection logic changes:

- What new behavior is detected?

## Checklist

- [ ] No real secrets or customer data are included.
- [ ] Tests pass.
- [ ] New detection logic includes test coverage.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where needed.
- [ ] The change remains vendor-neutral.
